decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block FAQ content, retains only Small Block prizes, and updates the purchase allocation. No additional correction is required.
Removing Big Block prizes does not change the automatic-wallet-transfer payout mode for the continuing Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_lifecycle key and narrows the contexts to the continuing Small Block system.
The landing-page tease refers generically to prize-draw tickets and remains accurate for the continuing Small Block prizes; it contains no Big Block-specific state.
The requirement specifies one prize ticket for a no-referral mint without retaining a Big Block-specific ticket attribute, so it remains valid unchanged.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already limits applicable_draws to SMALL_BLOCK while preserving the unchanged Chainlink VRF selection behavior.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible metadata key.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes big_block_tickets_per_referral_mint while preserving Small Block ticket issuance.
The new allocation retains the $10 affiliate commission, and the source does not change the no-referral trigger or random-recipient rule.
The prize-mechanics and purchase-allocation decision does not change the current or planned product names.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $8 purchase allocation to the continuing Small Block prize pool; its other mechanics remain unchanged.
Removing Big Block prizes and changing the purchase allocation has no effect on displaying the book cover on the landing page.
